label: Detailed RL1 map
rule: Every entity with a sourced or graded relationship to RL1 (members, validators, operator, supporters, ecosystem, vendors, peers, prospects).

label: ECB list of supervised entities: significant institutions
rule: Every significant banking group, listed by its head entity (subsidiaries roll up).

label: ECB list of supervised entities: less significant institutions
rule: Credit institutions only (1958). Excluded 1460 local savings, cooperative, Raiffeisen, rural and municipal banks (name match incl. German "eG", Finnish Osuuspankki/Säästöpankki, Spanish Cajas Rurales, Portuguese Crédito Agrícola caixas), which reach RL1 through their central institutions (DekaBank and Landesbanken, DZ BANK, Raiffeisen Landesbanken, ICCREA/Cassa Centrale, Crédit Agricole SA); holding companies and branches also excluded.

label: ESMA register: regulated markets, MTFs, OTFs, SME growth markets
rule: Active venues, grouped by operator LEI (one institution per operator, its MIC codes kept in the reference).

label: ESMA interim MiCA register: e-money token issuers
rule: Issuers without an authorisation end date, one row per issuer (several tokens roll up).

label: ESMA interim MiCA register: crypto-asset service providers
rule: Authorised CASPs without an end date, one per LEI; service codes a–j as in MiCA Art. 3(1)(16).

label: Hub players dataset
rule: Global market-infrastructure players already documented in the hub, with HQ city.

label: Curated: global FMIs, banks, exchanges, asset managers, digital-asset infrastructure
rule: Institutions no machine-readable public register lists: CSDs and CCPs outside the ESMA registers, banks outside the euro area, non-EU exchanges, large asset managers, tokenisation and custody firms. Compiled, not register-verified.

label: DefiLlama: chains by DeFi TVL
rule: Top 40 chains by total value locked.

label: DefiLlama: centralised exchanges (proof of reserves)
rule: Every CEX with at least $1m of tracked on-chain reserves; headquarters not geocoded.

label: DefiLlama: dApp / DeFi protocols
rule: Protocols grouped by parent (versions roll up), TVL ≥ $75m; excluded categories: CEX, Chain, Ponzi, Luck Games, Yield Lottery, Gamified Mining, Telegram Bot, Physical TCG, Canonical Bridge.

label: GLEIF LEI records (legal name and HQ city)
rule: Used to resolve legal names and HQ cities for every record with an LEI; not a source of institutions.

label: GeoNames cities15000 + country info
rule: Geocodes HQ cities; falls back to the national capital (marked) when the city can't be matched.
